description: Compare the export presets (export_presets.cfg) with what the scripts and scenes load, without exporting: files that exclude_filter leaves out although they are preloaded or loaded (Godot leaves them out even when something needs them, so the build fails there), plain data files (text, binary, GeoJSON, cfg, XML, YAML; JSON and imported CSV are fine) that Godot only exports when include_filter names them, paths built at run time under an excluded folder, a BOM that makes Godot read no presets; plus whether export templates are installed. `preset` limits it to one preset (name or number). `pck`: read an exported .pck (or a game executable with the pack inside) instead, without Godot, and compare it with the project: files the game loads that are missing, editor-only and test files shipped. Read-only. Run it before an export and after changing what the game loads; godot_export_run exports for real.

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

pck.description: an exported .pck or game executable to read and compare

preset.description: only this preset (its name or number)

name: godot_export
title: Check what the exported game will hold
